operating_rules: Keep Discord usable if Carl-bot is offline.
No routine @everyone pings; use opt-in notification roles.
Do not store rights, payment, contract, unreleased-master, credential, or entitlement data in public Discord.
One automation owner per routine signal to prevent duplicate posts.
Use slash commands first; legacy prefixes are transitional only because Carl-bot is retiring prefix commands.
Do not purge official event threads, support history, moderation evidence, rights/submission records, or automation audit logs.
Level roles and voice-linked roles are recognition/presence signals only and grant no authority or private access.
All public-facing automation must preserve Reset Inner Circle access and the resetinnercircle.com gateway.

command_migration.policy: Do not build new workflows that depend on prefixes. Existing event tags should be callable through Carl's slash/tag surface where supported; retain legacy aliases only during transition.
